summary: Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI) showcased its solutions at TAITRONICS Autumn and TaiwanRFID and held "The 4th Jinyi Award Ceremony" and a "Photovoltaic Applications on Construction Seminar" alongside the PV Taiwan Forum and Exhibition. For the Jinyi Award ITRI set a special pavilion displaying nominated products and solar-energy solutions, saying the award encourages applying creations in solar energy to human life and hopes they can be transformed into valued products; ITRI cooperated with Taiwan Design Center supervised by the Taiwan External Trade Development Council (TAITRA), and the competition — which has Product Design, Professional Design and Design Competition groups — named winners of the Professional Design Group and the 1st and 2nd places of the Design Competition Group. After the ceremony ITRI held the seminar for participants from the semiconductor, photovoltaic, environment and construction industries where Dr. Joeng-shein Chen, Deputy Manager of the Photovoltaics Technology Center of ITRI, said governments and companies in Taiwan should learn from successful cases in Europe and the USA, that ITRI has started photovoltaic and solar energy construction in South Taiwan, and that photovoltaic and solar energy are valuable sources affecting issues such as rising oil prices, the greenhouse effect and changing environmental awareness.
